snippet.title: Lethal Honor: Order of the Apocalypse // Release Date Teaser
snippet.description:
#LethalHonor #RogueLite #HackAndSlash

Lethal Honor: Order of the Apocalypse will be available on STEAM, EPIC GAME STORE, GOG, PLAYSTATION 5, and XBOX X|S on October 7th, 2025.

Presented as a living graphic novel, Lethal Honor thrusts players into a clandestine war against eldritch horrors. The game’s dark narrative unfolds through gameplay, with each death revealing new clues to a horrifying mystery. Players must master fast-paced, punishing combat, combining a vast arsenal of abilities and artifacts to survive against overwhelming odds on the cursed Wolf Island.

The truth is waiting. The Order of the Apocalypse is recruiting. Add Lethal Honor to your Steam Wishlist today to be notified when the conspiracy goes live.

STEAM - https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266060/Lethal_Honor__Order_of_the_Apocalypse/
EPIC - https://store.epicgames.com/p/lethal-honor-order-of-the-apocalypse-84604c
GOG - https://www.gog.com/game/lethal_honor_order_of_the_apocalypse
PS5 - https://store.playstation.com/concept/10007936/
XBOX - https://www.xbox.com/games/store/lethal-honor-order-of-the-apocalypse/9mxhsc4wtk5m
